blocks.x: How Achala Forge is put together: the layers, the controls and the lineage that your governance team asks about first.
Structurally Achala Forge is planes, not layers, workload, decision and evidence run in parallel behind one governed API, and each crossing is logged with policy version and owner.
the build decomposes into named pieces, each with an owner and a gate, Achala Forge architecture edition:

items: feature store, vector search, retrieval services
owned, SLA'd products with consumer contracts

blocks.x: In Achala Forge, instrumented from week one, on your channels:

items: sharing without exposure for data products

blocks.x: Runtime dependencies: Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka, dbt, Unity Catalog/Purview. Deployment runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys; the evidence export is formatted for the audit formats your team already uses.

Deployment models for Achala Forge follow the estate: in-perimeter on customer-managed keys, or in a segregated enclave where the estate cannot host the workload. Either way the control pack, the replay log and the audit export keep the same format, so the second deployment never re-argues the first.
Bring one data domain to a briefing. We will show the contract, the pipeline and the cost picture it would run under.
